title: A playlist class
description:
Write a class `Playlist` that keeps its songs private and valid:

```csharp
var p = new Playlist("Road trip");
p.Add("Africa", 295);              // title and length in seconds
p.Add("Holiday", 380);
p.Name = "  Summer ";              // trimmed: "Summer"
p.Count;                           // 2
p.TotalSeconds;                    // 675
p.Duration;                        // "11:15"; over an hour "1:02:05"
p.Remove("holiday");               // true: the first song with that title, ignoring case
p.Titles;                          // a read-only list of titles, in order
```

- `Name`: a property whose setter trims the value and throws an `ArgumentException` for an empty or blank name (also in the constructor).
- `Add` throws an `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` for a length of 0 or less, and an `ArgumentException` for a blank title.
- `Duration` is `m:ss` under an hour and `h:mm:ss` from an hour on.
- `Titles` is an `IReadOnlyList<string>`: changing the playlist afterwards must not change a list you got earlier, and callers cannot add to it.
hints: Validate in the `Name` setter and assign `Name = name` in the constructor, so the same check covers both.
`list.ToList().AsReadOnly()` makes a copy wrapped so that callers cannot change it.
